title: Was this mall world??
content: I just found out about mall world yesterday morning after waking up from this odd lucid dream that I just had to google what it meant. It started off with me in a store inside of a mall with a friend who I had no idea who she was but I guess she was my friend. She started off by saying “come on let’s go to the food court your mom is waiting” and I heard my mom call my name immediately after she said that. The friend said “I’ll meet you there” and ran out of the store and went right. I walked out the store and out of nowhere the mall had people walking but they didn’t have eyes just a nose and mouth. The mall was quiet but I could hear like a hum, ambiance like sound, and the footsteps of everyone walking(the footsteps were echoing) I tried talking to the people and some would stop and speak straight up gibberish while the others would just keep walking. I decide to go left instead of right(I’m freaking out at this point because I realize this isn’t real) all of a sudden a girl with black hair and bangs(she had a face btw) comes from behind me and tells me to follow her and tries leading me down these weird stairs that looked like it led nowhere. She already made her way halfway down the steps while I watched her from the top of the steps. Like the idiot I am I say out loud in a panic “this isn’t real” “this is a dream” “this isn’t real” and the girl stopped and looked at me with concern or like she knew something was going to happen after I said that. So after I said that everything just became a nightmare. I can’t really explain that part honestly because before it could turn bad thats when my husband shook me awake to let me know that our dog threw up on the bed 💀 I am someone that lucid dreams almost everyday and sometimes they turn scary but I’ve never had one give me this much anxiety after waking up. It’s 1am rn and I’m too nervous to sleep because I don’t want to re-visit that dream. (Sorry if my explanation sucks)
